description: PopulationStudy Experiment 4: pretrained anatomy encoder on LIDC-IDRI (masked CT autoencoder), then freeze and splice into CRB DVF nets on the Experiment 2/3 SPARE split.

pack.note: Crop R231 lung bbox + 8 vx, resample 128^3. Same geometry recipe as PopulationStudy SPARE DVF library. Intensities stored as HU; loaders min-max per volume like SPARE.

run.note: Encoder/Both side-branch code is in place; do not launch those trainings in E4.
